scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cp-notes/shared && concurrently -n backend,website -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cp-notes/backend" "npm run dev -w @cp-notes/website"
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build -w @cp-notes/shared && npm run dev -w @cp-notes/extension
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cp-notes/shared && npm run build -w @cp-notes/backend && npm run build -w @cp-notes/website && npm run build -w @cp-notes/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cp-notes/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cp-notes/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
